label: S.J.Res. 86
title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "Air Plan Approval; South Dakota; Regional Haze Plan for the Second Implementation Period".

items.snippet: This joint resolution nullifies the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) final rule titled Air Plan Approval;
(The regional haze rule requires states to take actions to improve visibility in national parks and wilderness areas.)

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
